game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge, a rope bridge over a crevasse: the ice axe ranger must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge: a rope bridge over a crevasse
core_gameplay_loop: In Crevasse Bridge, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the gate value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about gate to power up the ice axe ranger and open the rope bridge.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Crevasse Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Crevasse Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
